question: Is manifestation something other than activity gone into all accomplishment?
premises: Manifestation is not other than activity.
Activity is present in all accomplishment.
inference: Manifestation is activity absorbed into all accomplishment, not a separate entity.
uncertainties: Exact force of tat+gatā remains unresolved.
plain_english: Activity is in all accomplishment; manifestation is not something else, but has gone into that.
